phase_name: Verification arms (1)-(4) for the widened gate

objectives.description: Arm 1: linear complete plan -> ALLOWED, case 2/3 label
Arm 2: branched incident-shaped plan -> ALLOWED via 7/7 corroboration, banner
Arm 3: bare shortfall -> REFUSED case 1/3, phases_total not zeroed, no defect record
Arm 4: under-reported phases_total -> REFUSED case 3/3, defect record unchanged
Falsification check: unconditional overwrite flips arm 3's assertions to FAIL

deviations.description: Assert the [phase-check] warning still fires on the completing transition for arm 2
deviations.reason: Verified empirically against the real update-task-status.sh (deployed copy, unmodified by task 259): its own count_plan_phases()-derived DONE/TOTAL for a genuinely 7/7-closed plan takes the 'DONE >= TOTAL -> proceeding' branch (update-task-status.sh:480), not the WARNING branch (:494), which only fires when DONE < TOTAL. The plan's claim describes the shortfall (arm 3) shape, not arm 2's fully-corroborated-closed shape. No test asserting the false claim was written; the correct 'proceeds silently' behavior was confirmed by direct invocation instead.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- plan's phase-check sub-claim verified inaccurate for arm 2, corrected via direct empirical check rather than encoded as a false test assertion)*

deviations.reason: All four arms (including case-label and defect-record assertions) were expressed in test-corroborate-phase-counts.sh via a new corroborate_and_gate() helper reproducing orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's exact widened call sequence, rather than in test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh. That suite carries a large, pre-existing, unrelated flakiness surface (34/110 cases already failing before this task's first edit, confirmed via git stash bisection) that adding new cases there would inherit for no additional verification benefit.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- arms expressed in the lighter-weight, unaffected harness instead)*
